content: How do I import qualitative data into GEO?

Option 1: Export to File; select Export to File, browse to a location, enter a file name, and select Save.
Option 2: Export to Clipboard; select Export to Clipboard, open an external application (i.e. Excel), paste the contents of your clipboard.
Option 3: Import from File; select Import from File, browse to the .txt file, select it, and Open.
